main_loop.watchdog: g_frame stops advancing when the bad state is reached

threads.main: holds lock A (g_lock_a), waits for lock B inside fx_main_lock_a_then_b
threads.worker: fx_worker_b_then_a: holds lock B (g_lock_b), waits for lock A

deadlock.locks: two CRITICAL_SECTIONs; each waiter's blocker is the other thread (owner resolvable from OwningThread)
deadlock.pattern: N=2 threads waiting on locks held by each other

suspend_all.worker_state: waits inside the fault handler (thread inside the host's fault handler)
suspend_all.pattern: all threads suspended by thread T (T = the worker in the handler)
suspend_all.fault: read of a decommitted page at g_freed

answers.dump: --dump writes a minidump of the process itself (MDMP magic) from the reaper thread while the bad state holds
answers.exit: the reaper ends the process with exit code 0 after --hold seconds; the safety watchdog exits 99 after hold+40 s
